description: Turn a text prompt into an animated GIF on AI GIF Maker (aigifmaker.ai) and return the GIF URL. Native GIF generation, no video conversion; usually about a minute. Costs 1 credit on the AI GIF Maker account behind AIGIFMAKER_API_KEY, the same as on the website.

prompt.description: What the GIF should show and how it moves, e.g. "a corgi in sunglasses dancing on a beach, looping".

name: generate_gif
title: Generate an animated GIF
